scientific_integrity: Mathematical proof with exact finite-population identities and exact rational implementation checks; no external independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Fixed deterministic vector data; not a trajectory-wise stochastic optimization convergence theorem.
Equal size labeled blocks, uniform block permutation, deterministic within-block order, finite-dimensional Euclidean vectors.
Classical whole-cluster variance results precede the complete-block identity; originality claim is restricted to the attained exact all-prefix spectral law and strict partial-prefix comparison.
Possible equivalent survey-sampling formulations of partially filled clusters remain an unresolved bibliographic risk.
title: Sharp all-prefix risk profile for uniformly permuted fixed-order blocks
